title: Skill systems playbook & manager ask tracker
content:
Skill systems playbook — quick personal notebook (notes to self)

Purpose:
- Build a repeatable, observable practice loop for two skill areas this quarter: coaching calibration and onboarding flow design.
- Convert vague activity into measurable evidence for calibration conversations and promotion thread.
- Keep manager asks small, concrete, and time-bound so they are easy to approve and track.

Topline 90-day goals (what success looks like):
1) Coaching calibration: run 6 paired calibration sessions, capture 12 exemplar snippets with rubric-level annotations, and drive one team-level coaching workshop. Evidence: short clips/transcripts + one pager summary.
2) Onboarding flow design: ship a hypothesis-driven checklist + 2 micro-updates to the onboarding templates; measure NPS-change in the pilot cohort (target +8 points). Evidence: before/after checklist + pilot feedback summary.

Weekly micro-practice cadence (my experiment):
- Mon (30m): plan week (hard priority = one small deliverable for each goal).
- Tue (45m): practice coaching calibration — 2 simulated snippets, note rubric alignment.
- Wed (30m): template iteration + quick sync w/producer.
- Thu (60m): paired calibration with peer (Samir/Dina) — record 2 short clips.
- Fri (15m): evidence capture + 5-min reflection.
Notes: aim for 45–60 mins of focused practice on Tues/Thu; treat Wed slot as prototyping time (low fidelity ok).

Evidence capture template (one-liners to paste into doc):
- Date: 2025-02-25
- Artifact type: paired calibration clip / onboarding checklist draft / pilot feedback
- Short description: what happened (1–2 sentences)
- Metric or rubric line observed: e.g., "Identified behavior X with rubric level 3"
- Impact note: why this matters for promotion criteria or team outcome
- Attachments/links: link to recording / doc / pilot results (put URL)

Example entry (for copy):
- Date: 2025-02-20
- Artifact type: paired calibration clip
- Short description: 8-min recorded coaching sample where I nudged an engineer to reframe a tradeoff; identified missed opportunity to surface assumption about latency targets.
- Metric/rubric: "Generates clear tradeoff frames" rated 2->3 after feedback.
- Impact: shows trajectory on situational coaching, useful for promotion narrative.
- Attachments: drive link to clip

Manager asks (short, actionable asks I want to surface at next 1:1):
- Ask A: Approve 8 hours of paired calibration time for Q2 (2 hrs/month), and OK to book Samir as peer reviewer. Reason: will produce artifacts for calibration deck and promotion thread.
- Ask B: Support for pilot cohort: greenlight 12 new hires to be enrolled in the redesigned onboarding checklist pilot in April.
- Ask C: Quick feedback on rubric draft (attached) by Mar 10 — a 20-min async read will unblock finalization.
How I'll frame them in 1:1: three bullets, time estimate, and expected deliverable/outcome.

Risk register (things that could derail progress):
- Blocker: Calendar friction — peers can't commit to paired sessions. Mitigation: prebook 2 recurring slots and rotate who covers.
- Blocker: Low pilot enrollment. Mitigation: coordinate with hiring ops and set explicit opt-in process.

Metrics to show progress (simple & manager-friendly):
- Artifact count (target 12 calibration snippets by June)
- Workshop executed (Y/N) + attendees count
- Onboarding pilot NPS delta (+/-) and qualitative themes (3 bullet summary)

Reflection prompts (for Friday 5-min capture):
- What concrete evidence did I produce this week? (link it)
- What moved the needle? (one sentence)
- What blocked me and can I remove it next week? (one sentence)
- One small win to celebrate (one sentence)

Open questions / quick backlog (notes to self):
- Should I include short transcript snippets or full recordings for calibration artifacts? (pros/cons: transcripts easier to skim; clips convey tone)
- What's the minimum viable pilot size to detect NPS change? (ask analytics)
- Which rubric lines directly map to promotion criteria vs team coaching signals? (map next session)

Next actions (priority ordered):
1) Draft 1-page rubric summary and send to manager for 20-min async review (deadline Mar 10).
2) Book two recurring 45-min paired calibration slots with Samir and Dina (1 per month).
3) Draft onboarding checklist v0.2 and recruit first 8 hires for alpha pilot (owner: Claire, due Mar 21).
4) Capture 3 evidence entries this week (use template above).

Tone notes to self:
- Keep artifacts short and skimmable — managers prefer bullets + links.
- When asking for time, always show expected output and timeline.
- Treat recordings as working artifacts; redact sensitive parts before sharing externally.

Unresolved / thinking-out-loud (messy):
- Maybe combine the calibration clips into 90-sec highlights for quick review. Could build a 1-page "before/after" slide per clip showing rubric change.
- Wondering whether to trial a "coaching office hours" slot where people bring 5-min cases and we do live micro-coaching. Low friction.

Quick meeting prep for next 1:1 (3 bullets):
- Share quick doc link + 2 exemplar artifacts (1 calibration clip, 1 checklist).
- Ask A/B/C from the "Manager asks" section; get commitment or next steps.
- Confirm timeline for pilot and owner responsibilities.

-- end --

(Keep editing. This stays personal. Archive artifacts into /shared_drives/company/people-ops/evidence once reviewed.)
